_doc: Cốc Vũ Quán Effect engine records (world-depth Stage 6; ADR-0009). Merged into assets/data/combat_effects.json under source world-depth:coc_vu. Unpriced.

Moistens Without a Sound.rule: Canon of the Good Rain (passive art, unlock layer 4): each heal restored to you (at most 3 a pulse) adds 1 Wood buff stack for 8 s.

Water Wears the Stone.rule: Canon of the Good Rain (passive art, unlock layer 6, authored wish d24): each heal restored to you (at most 3 a pulse) drips on the foe as a free Physical hit of 0.15 + 0.01 per Wood buff stack you hold.
Water Wears the Stone.approx: free_hit carries dtype phys with no art tag param (d24 calls for a Physical hit tagged moc).

The Good Rain Knows Its Season.rule: Banner That Calls the Grain Rain: for the first 10 s of a fight your heals are halved (-50 healing); from 10 s onward while held, you heal 1 % of your maximum health each second.
The Good Rain Knows Its Season.approx: Banner charge is satisfied while the Banner is worn from 10 s onward.

Rain That Does Not Stop.rule: The Grain Rain, full set (3 pieces): once your healing rain begins, it stays on the field until you fall. For every 10 s it has fallen, you gain +10 % healing and pay 1 % of your maximum health each second (unreduced upkeep).
